title.th: Check the pack first

text.zh-TW: 這包前 21 顆是有效錠，後 7 顆是無效錠。請從第 1 顆有效錠開始。若吃錯順序，已先吃到無效錠，今天改吃有效錠；接下來 7 天加用保險套。
text.en: The first 21 tablets are active. The last 7 tablets are inactive. Start with the first active tablet. If tablets were taken in the wrong order and you already took inactive tablets first, switch to an active tablet today and use condoms for the next 7 days.
text.id: The first 21 tablets are active. The last 7 tablets are inactive. Start with the first active tablet. If tablets were taken in the wrong order and you already took inactive tablets first, switch to an active tablet today and use condoms for the next 7 days.
text.vi: The first 21 tablets are active. The last 7 tablets are inactive. Start with the first active tablet. If tablets were taken in the wrong order and you already took inactive tablets first, switch to an active tablet today and use condoms for the next 7 days.
text.th: The first 21 tablets are active. The last 7 tablets are inactive. Start with the first active tablet. If tablets were taken in the wrong order and you already took inactive tablets first, switch to an active tablet today and use condoms for the next 7 days.
text.tl: The first 21 tablets are active. The last 7 tablets are inactive. Start with the first active tablet. If tablets were taken in the wrong order and you already took inactive tablets first, switch to an active tablet today and use condoms for the next 7 days.
text.ja: The first 21 tablets are active. The last 7 tablets are inactive. Start with the first active tablet. If tablets were taken in the wrong order and you already took inactive tablets first, switch to an active tablet today and use condoms for the next 7 days.

action.zh-TW: 月經第 1～5 天開始吃第 1 顆有效錠
action.en: Start the first active tablet on menstrual day 1 to 5
action.id: Mulai tablet aktif pertama pada hari haid ke-1 sampai ke-5
action.vi: Bắt đầu viên có hoạt chất đầu tiên vào ngày 1 đến ngày 5 của kỳ kinh
action.th: เริ่มกินเม็ดยาที่มีตัวยาเม็ดแรกในวันที่ 1–5 ของประจำเดือน
action.tl: Simulan ang unang aktibong tableta sa araw 1 hanggang 5 ng regla
action.ja: 月経1〜5日目に最初の有効錠を飲む

note.zh-TW: 搭配白開水整顆吞服。若不是第 1 天開始，前 7 天加用保險套。
note.en: Swallow it whole with water. If you do not start on day 1, use condoms for the first 7 days.
note.id: Telan utuh dengan air putih. Jika tidak mulai pada hari ke-1, gunakan kondom selama 7 hari pertama.
note.vi: Nuốt nguyên viên với nước lọc. Nếu không bắt đầu vào ngày 1, dùng bao cao su trong 7 ngày đầu.
note.th: กลืนทั้งเม็ดกับน้ำเปล่า หากไม่ได้เริ่มวันที่ 1 ให้ใช้ถุงยางใน 7 วันแรก
note.tl: Lunukin nang buo kasama ng tubig. Kung hindi nagsimula sa araw 1, gumamit ng condom sa unang 7 araw.
note.ja: 水で錠剤をそのまま飲みます。1日目以外に開始した場合、最初の7日間はコンドームを使ってください。

action.zh-TW: 每天固定時間吃 1 顆
action.en: Take 1 tablet at the same time each day
action.id: Minum 1 tablet pada waktu yang sama setiap hari
action.vi: Uống 1 viên vào cùng một giờ mỗi ngày
action.th: กินวันละ 1 เม็ด เวลาเดิมทุกวัน
action.tl: Uminom ng 1 tableta sa parehong oras araw-araw
action.ja: 毎日同じ時刻に1錠飲む

note.zh-TW: 依包裝順序吃。前 21 顆有效，後 7 顆無效。
note.en: Follow the pack order. The first 21 tablets are active. The last 7 tablets are inactive.
note.id: Ikuti urutan pada kemasan. 21 tablet pertama aktif, 7 tablet terakhir tidak aktif.
note.vi: Uống theo thứ tự trên vỉ. 21 viên đầu có hoạt chất, 7 viên cuối không hoạt chất.
note.th: กินตามลำดับบนแผงยา 21 เม็ดแรกมีตัวยา 7 เม็ดหลังไม่มีตัวยา
note.tl: Sundin ang pagkakasunod sa pakete. Ang unang 21 ay aktibo; ang huling 7 ay hindi aktibo.
note.ja: シートの順番どおりに飲みます。最初の21錠は有効錠、最後の7錠は無効錠です。

action.zh-TW: 吃完 28 顆後隔天開新包
action.en: After 28 tablets, start a new pack the next day
action.id: Setelah 28 tablet, mulai kemasan baru keesokan harinya
action.vi: Uống hết 28 viên, hôm sau bắt đầu vỉ mới
action.th: กินครบ 28 เม็ดแล้ว เริ่มแผงใหม่ในวันถัดไป
action.tl: Pagkatapos ng 28 tableta, magsimula ng bagong pakete kinabukasan
action.ja: 28錠を飲み終えたら翌日に新しいシートを始める

note.zh-TW: 不要中斷。月經通常在後 7 顆無效錠期間來。
note.en: Do not stop. Bleeding usually starts during the last 7 inactive tablets.
note.id: Jangan berhenti. Perdarahan biasanya terjadi saat 7 tablet tidak aktif terakhir.
note.vi: Không ngưng thuốc. Ra máu thường xảy ra khi uống 7 viên không hoạt chất cuối.
note.th: ไม่ต้องหยุดยา เลือดมักมาระหว่างกิน 7 เม็ดหลังที่ไม่มีตัวยา
note.tl: Huwag huminto. Karaniwang may pagdurugo habang iniinom ang huling 7 hindi aktibong tableta.
note.ja: 中断しないでください。出血は通常、最後の7錠の無効錠の期間に起こります。

action.en: If you miss 1 active tablet
action.id: Jika lupa 1 tablet aktif
action.vi: Nếu quên 1 viên có hoạt chất
action.th: หากลืมเม็ดยาที่มีตัวยา 1 เม็ด
action.tl: Kung nakalimutan ang 1 aktibong tableta
action.ja: 有効錠を1錠飲み忘れた場合

note.zh-TW: 想起時立刻補吃，下一顆照原時間吃；通常不需加用保險套。
note.en: Take it as soon as you remember, then take the next one at the usual time. Condoms are usually not needed.
note.id: Segera minum saat ingat, lalu minum tablet berikutnya pada waktu biasa. Biasanya tidak perlu kondom.
note.vi: Uống ngay khi nhớ ra, rồi uống viên tiếp theo vào giờ thường lệ. Thường không cần dùng bao cao su.
note.th: นึกได้ให้กินทันที แล้วกินเม็ดถัดไปตามเวลาเดิม โดยทั่วไปไม่ต้องใช้ถุงยางเพิ่ม
note.tl: Inumin agad kapag naalala, pagkatapos ay inumin ang susunod sa karaniwang oras. Karaniwang hindi kailangan ng condom.
note.ja: 気づいた時にすぐ飲み、次の錠剤は通常の時刻に飲みます。通常、コンドーム追加は不要です。

action.en: If tablets are missed in weeks 1 to 2
action.id: Jika ada tablet yang terlupa pada minggu 1 sampai ke-2
action.vi: Nếu quên thuốc trong tuần 1 đến tuần 2
action.th: หากลืมยาในสัปดาห์ที่ 1–2
action.tl: Kung may nakalimutang tableta sa linggo 1 hanggang 2
action.ja: 1〜2週目に飲み忘れた場合

note.zh-TW: 補最近漏的 1 顆，今天該吃的也照吃。其他漏掉的丟棄；接下來 7 天加用保險套。
note.en: Take the most recent missed tablet and take today's tablet as usual. Discard the other missed tablets. Use condoms for the next 7 days.
note.id: Minum tablet yang paling baru terlupa dan tablet hari ini seperti biasa. Buang tablet lain yang terlupa; gunakan kondom 7 hari.
note.vi: Uống viên quên gần nhất và viên của hôm nay như thường lệ. Bỏ các viên quên khác; dùng bao cao su trong 7 ngày.
note.th: กินเม็ดที่ลืมล่าสุดและเม็ดของวันนี้ตามปกติ ทิ้งเม็ดที่ลืมอื่น ๆ และใช้ถุงยาง 7 วัน
note.tl: Inumin ang pinakahuling nakalimutan at ang tableta para sa araw na ito gaya ng dati. Itapon ang iba pang nakalimutan; gumamit ng condom sa loob ng 7 araw.
note.ja: 直近で飲み忘れた1錠と今日の分を飲みます。ほかの飲み忘れ錠は捨て、7日間はコンドームを使ってください。

action.en: If tablets are missed in week 3
action.id: Jika ada tablet yang terlupa pada minggu ke-3
action.vi: Nếu quên thuốc trong tuần 3
action.th: หากลืมยาในสัปดาห์ที่ 3
action.tl: Kung may nakalimutang tableta sa linggo 3
action.ja: 3週目に飲み忘れた場合

note.zh-TW: 補最近漏的 1 顆，吃完剩下有效錠後，丟掉後 7 顆無效錠，隔天直接開新包；這個週期可能沒有月經，屬正常現象。接下來 7 天加用保險套。
note.en: Take the most recent missed tablet. Finish the remaining active tablets, discard the last 7 inactive tablets, and start a new pack the next day. It is normal if you do not have a period during this cycle. Use condoms for the next 7 days.
note.id: Minum tablet yang paling baru terlupa. Habiskan tablet aktif, buang 7 tablet tidak aktif terakhir, lalu mulai kemasan baru keesokan harinya. Gunakan kondom 7 hari.
note.vi: Uống viên quên gần nhất. Uống hết viên có hoạt chất, bỏ 7 viên không hoạt chất cuối rồi hôm sau bắt đầu vỉ mới. Dùng bao cao su 7 ngày.
note.th: กินเม็ดที่ลืมล่าสุด กินเม็ดที่มีตัวยาจนหมด ทิ้ง 7 เม็ดหลังที่ไม่มีตัวยา แล้วเริ่มแผงใหม่วันถัดไป ใช้ถุงยาง 7 วัน
note.tl: Inumin ang pinakahuling nakalimutan. Tapusin ang aktibong tableta, itapon ang huling 7 hindi aktibo, at magsimula ng bagong pakete kinabukasan. Gumamit ng condom 7 araw.
note.ja: 直近で飲み忘れた1錠を飲み、有効錠を飲み切ります。最後の7錠の無効錠は捨て、翌日に新しいシートを始め、7日間コンドームを使ってください。

title.th: Vomiting or severe diarrhea

text.zh-TW: 吃有效錠後 3～4 小時內嘔吐，或有嚴重腹瀉時，藥可能沒有吸收完全。請當作漏吃有效錠處理；若需要補 1 顆，可從另一包拿 1 顆補。
text.en: If you vomit within 3 to 4 hours after an active tablet, or if you have severe diarrhea, the pill may not be fully absorbed. Treat this like a missed active tablet. If you need one extra tablet, take it from another pack.
text.id: If you vomit within 3 to 4 hours after an active tablet, or if you have severe diarrhea, the pill may not be fully absorbed. Treat this like a missed active tablet. If you need one extra tablet, take it from another pack.
text.vi: If you vomit within 3 to 4 hours after an active tablet, or if you have severe diarrhea, the pill may not be fully absorbed. Treat this like a missed active tablet. If you need one extra tablet, take it from another pack.
text.th: If you vomit within 3 to 4 hours after an active tablet, or if you have severe diarrhea, the pill may not be fully absorbed. Treat this like a missed active tablet. If you need one extra tablet, take it from another pack.
text.tl: If you vomit within 3 to 4 hours after an active tablet, or if you have severe diarrhea, the pill may not be fully absorbed. Treat this like a missed active tablet. If you need one extra tablet, take it from another pack.
text.ja: If you vomit within 3 to 4 hours after an active tablet, or if you have severe diarrhea, the pill may not be fully absorbed. Treat this like a missed active tablet. If you need one extra tablet, take it from another pack.

title.th: Bleeding changes

text.zh-TW: 剛開始服用時，少量點狀出血可能發生，請不要自行停藥。月經通常在後 7 顆無效錠期間來。若出血量持續增加、超過一週未停止，或無效錠期間沒有出血且曾漏吃藥，請驗孕或回診。
text.en: Light spotting may happen when you first start, so do not stop the pill on your own. Bleeding usually starts during the last 7 inactive tablets. If bleeding keeps getting heavier, lasts more than a week, or there is no bleeding during the inactive-tablet interval after missed tablets, take a pregnancy test or return to the doctor.
text.id: Light spotting may happen when you first start, so do not stop the pill on your own. Bleeding usually starts during the last 7 inactive tablets. If bleeding keeps getting heavier, lasts more than a week, or there is no bleeding during the inactive-tablet interval after missed tablets, take a pregnancy test or return to the doctor.

If bleeding keeps getting heavier, lasts more than a week, or there is no bleeding during the inactive-tablet interval after missed tablets, take a pregnancy test or return to the doctor.

If bleeding keeps getting heavier, lasts more than a week, or there is no bleeding during the inactive-tablet interval after missed tablets, take a pregnancy test or return to the doctor.

If bleeding keeps getting heavier, lasts more than a week, or there is no bleeding during the inactive-tablet interval after missed tablets, take a pregnancy test or return to the doctor.

If bleeding keeps getting heavier, lasts more than a week, or there is no bleeding during the inactive-tablet interval after missed tablets, take a pregnancy test or return to the doctor.

text.zh-TW: 胸痛、喘、單側小腿腫痛或突然視力模糊：停藥並立即就醫。
text.en: Chest pain, shortness of breath, one swollen painful calf, or sudden blurry vision: stop the pill and seek care now.
text.id: Nyeri dada, sesak napas, satu betis bengkak dan nyeri, atau penglihatan tiba-tiba kabur: hentikan pil dan segera cari pertolongan medis.
text.vi: Đau ngực, khó thở, một bên bắp chân sưng đau hoặc đột ngột mờ mắt: ngưng thuốc và đi khám ngay.
text.th: เจ็บหน้าอก หายใจลำบาก น่องข้างเดียวบวมเจ็บ หรือจู่ ๆ ตามัว: หยุดยาและพบแพทย์ทันที
text.tl: Pananakit ng dibdib, hingal, isang binti na namamaga at masakit, o biglang paglabo ng paningin: ihinto ang pills at magpatingin agad.
text.ja: 胸痛、息切れ、片側のふくらはぎの腫れや痛み、または急な視界のぼやけ：服用を中止し、直ちに受診してください。

text.zh-TW: 避孕藥不能預防性病；需要時仍要用保險套。
text.en: Birth control pills do not prevent STIs. Use condoms when needed.
text.id: Pil KB tidak mencegah infeksi menular seksual; gunakan kondom bila perlu.
text.vi: Thuốc tránh thai không phòng bệnh lây qua đường tình dục; dùng bao cao su khi cần.
text.th: ยาคุมกำเนิดไม่ป้องกันโรคติดต่อทางเพศสัมพันธ์ ควรใช้ถุงยางเมื่อจำเป็น
text.tl: Hindi pinipigilan ng birth control pills ang sexually transmitted infections; gumamit ng condom kung kailangan.
text.ja: 避妊薬は性感染症を予防できません。必要な時はコンドームを使ってください。

text.zh-TW: 前 1–3 個月身體適應時，可能會稍微容易出油或長小粉刺。
text.en: During the first 1 to 3 months, your body may be adjusting, so you may notice slightly more oiliness or small pimples.
text.id: Selama 1–3 bulan pertama saat tubuh sedang menyesuaikan diri, kulit bisa sedikit lebih berminyak atau muncul jerawat kecil.
text.vi: Trong 1–3 tháng đầu khi cơ thể đang thích nghi, da có thể hơi dễ đổ dầu hơn hoặc nổi các nốt mụn nhỏ.
text.th: ในช่วง 1–3 เดือนแรกที่ร่างกายกำลังปรับตัว อาจมีผิวมันขึ้นเล็กน้อยหรือมีสิวเม็ดเล็ก ๆ ได้บ้าง
text.tl: Sa unang 1–3 buwan habang nag-a-adjust pa ang katawan, maaaring medyo mas madaling mag-oily ang balat o magkaroon ng maliliit na pimples.
text.ja: 服用開始から1〜3か月ほどは体が慣れる過程で、やや皮脂が出やすくなったり、小さなにきびが出ることがあります。

action.zh-TW: 每天固定時間吃 1 顆
action.en: Take 1 tablet at the same time each day
action.id: Minum 1 tablet pada waktu yang sama setiap hari
action.vi: Uống 1 viên vào cùng một giờ mỗi ngày
action.th: กินวันละ 1 เม็ด เวลาเดิมทุกวัน
action.tl: Uminom ng 1 tableta sa parehong oras araw-araw
action.ja: 毎日同じ時刻に1錠飲む

note.zh-TW: 依包裝順序吃。前 21 顆有效，後 7 顆無效。
note.en: Follow the pack order. The first 21 tablets are active. The last 7 tablets are inactive.
note.id: Ikuti urutan pada kemasan. 21 tablet pertama aktif, 7 tablet terakhir tidak aktif.
note.vi: Uống theo thứ tự trên vỉ. 21 viên đầu có hoạt chất, 7 viên cuối không hoạt chất.
note.th: กินตามลำดับบนแผงยา 21 เม็ดแรกมีตัวยา 7 เม็ดหลังไม่มีตัวยา
note.tl: Sundin ang pagkakasunod sa pakete. Ang unang 21 ay aktibo; ang huling 7 ay hindi aktibo.
note.ja: シートの順番どおりに飲みます。最初の21錠は有効錠、最後の7錠は無効錠です。

action.zh-TW: 吃完 28 顆後隔天開新包
action.en: After 28 tablets, start a new pack the next day
action.id: Setelah 28 tablet, mulai kemasan baru keesokan harinya
action.vi: Uống hết 28 viên, hôm sau bắt đầu vỉ mới
action.th: กินครบ 28 เม็ดแล้ว เริ่มแผงใหม่ในวันถัดไป
action.tl: Pagkatapos ng 28 tableta, magsimula ng bagong pakete kinabukasan
action.ja: 28錠を飲み終えたら翌日に新しいシートを始める

note.zh-TW: 不要中斷。月經通常在後 7 顆無效錠期間來。
note.en: Do not stop. Bleeding usually starts during the last 7 inactive tablets.
note.id: Jangan berhenti. Perdarahan biasanya terjadi saat 7 tablet tidak aktif terakhir.
note.vi: Không ngưng thuốc. Ra máu thường xảy ra khi uống 7 viên không hoạt chất cuối.
note.th: ไม่ต้องหยุดยา เลือดมักมาระหว่างกิน 7 เม็ดหลังที่ไม่มีตัวยา
note.tl: Huwag huminto. Karaniwang may pagdurugo habang iniinom ang huling 7 hindi aktibong tableta.
note.ja: 中断しないでください。出血は通常、最後の7錠の無効錠の期間に起こります。

action.en: If you miss 1 active tablet
action.id: Jika lupa 1 tablet aktif
action.vi: Nếu quên 1 viên có hoạt chất
action.th: หากลืมเม็ดยาที่มีตัวยา 1 เม็ด
action.tl: Kung nakalimutan ang 1 aktibong tableta
action.ja: 有効錠を1錠飲み忘れた場合

note.zh-TW: 想起時立刻補吃，下一顆照原時間吃；通常不需加用保險套。
note.en: Take it as soon as you remember, then take the next one at the usual time. Condoms are usually not needed.
note.id: Segera minum saat ingat, lalu minum tablet berikutnya pada waktu biasa. Biasanya tidak perlu kondom.
note.vi: Uống ngay khi nhớ ra, rồi uống viên tiếp theo vào giờ thường lệ. Thường không cần dùng bao cao su.
note.th: นึกได้ให้กินทันที แล้วกินเม็ดถัดไปตามเวลาเดิม โดยทั่วไปไม่ต้องใช้ถุงยางเพิ่ม
note.tl: Inumin agad kapag naalala, pagkatapos ay inumin ang susunod sa karaniwang oras. Karaniwang hindi kailangan ng condom.
note.ja: 気づいた時にすぐ飲み、次の錠剤は通常の時刻に飲みます。通常、コンドーム追加は不要です。

action.en: If tablets are missed in weeks 1 to 2
action.id: Jika ada tablet yang terlupa pada minggu 1 sampai ke-2
action.vi: Nếu quên thuốc trong tuần 1 đến tuần 2
action.th: หากลืมยาในสัปดาห์ที่ 1–2
action.tl: Kung may nakalimutang tableta sa linggo 1 hanggang 2
action.ja: 1〜2週目に飲み忘れた場合

note.zh-TW: 補最近漏的 1 顆，今天該吃的也照吃。其他漏掉的丟棄；接下來 7 天加用保險套。
note.en: Take the most recent missed tablet and take today's tablet as usual. Discard the other missed tablets. Use condoms for the next 7 days.
note.id: Minum tablet yang paling baru terlupa dan tablet hari ini seperti biasa. Buang tablet lain yang terlupa; gunakan kondom 7 hari.
note.vi: Uống viên quên gần nhất và viên của hôm nay như thường lệ. Bỏ các viên quên khác; dùng bao cao su trong 7 ngày.
note.th: กินเม็ดที่ลืมล่าสุดและเม็ดของวันนี้ตามปกติ ทิ้งเม็ดที่ลืมอื่น ๆ และใช้ถุงยาง 7 วัน
note.tl: Inumin ang pinakahuling nakalimutan at ang tableta para sa araw na ito gaya ng dati. Itapon ang iba pang nakalimutan; gumamit ng condom sa loob ng 7 araw.
note.ja: 直近で飲み忘れた1錠と今日の分を飲みます。ほかの飲み忘れ錠は捨て、7日間はコンドームを使ってください。

action.en: If tablets are missed in week 3
action.id: Jika ada tablet yang terlupa pada minggu ke-3
action.vi: Nếu quên thuốc trong tuần 3
action.th: หากลืมยาในสัปดาห์ที่ 3
action.tl: Kung may nakalimutang tableta sa linggo 3
action.ja: 3週目に飲み忘れた場合

note.zh-TW: 補最近漏的 1 顆，吃完剩下有效錠後，丟掉後 7 顆無效錠，隔天直接開新包；這個週期可能沒有月經，屬正常現象。接下來 7 天加用保險套。
note.en: Take the most recent missed tablet. Finish the remaining active tablets, discard the last 7 inactive tablets, and start a new pack the next day. It is normal if you do not have a period during this cycle. Use condoms for the next 7 days.
note.id: Minum tablet yang paling baru terlupa. Habiskan tablet aktif, buang 7 tablet tidak aktif terakhir, lalu mulai kemasan baru keesokan harinya. Gunakan kondom 7 hari.
note.vi: Uống viên quên gần nhất. Uống hết viên có hoạt chất, bỏ 7 viên không hoạt chất cuối rồi hôm sau bắt đầu vỉ mới. Dùng bao cao su 7 ngày.
note.th: กินเม็ดที่ลืมล่าสุด กินเม็ดที่มีตัวยาจนหมด ทิ้ง 7 เม็ดหลังที่ไม่มีตัวยา แล้วเริ่มแผงใหม่วันถัดไป ใช้ถุงยาง 7 วัน
note.tl: Inumin ang pinakahuling nakalimutan. Tapusin ang aktibong tableta, itapon ang huling 7 hindi aktibo, at magsimula ng bagong pakete kinabukasan. Gumamit ng condom 7 araw.
note.ja: 直近で飲み忘れた1錠を飲み、有効錠を飲み切ります。最後の7錠の無効錠は捨て、翌日に新しいシートを始め、7日間コンドームを使ってください。

title.th: Vomiting or severe diarrhea

text.zh-TW: 吃有效錠後 3～4 小時內嘔吐，或有嚴重腹瀉時，藥可能沒有吸收完全。請當作漏吃有效錠處理；若需要補 1 顆，可從另一包拿 1 顆補。
text.en: If you vomit within 3 to 4 hours after an active tablet, or if you have severe diarrhea, the pill may not be fully absorbed. Treat this like a missed active tablet. If you need one extra tablet, take it from another pack.
text.id: If you vomit within 3 to 4 hours after an active tablet, or if you have severe diarrhea, the pill may not be fully absorbed. Treat this like a missed active tablet. If you need one extra tablet, take it from another pack.
text.vi: If you vomit within 3 to 4 hours after an active tablet, or if you have severe diarrhea, the pill may not be fully absorbed. Treat this like a missed active tablet. If you need one extra tablet, take it from another pack.

title.th: Bleeding changes

text.zh-TW: 剛開始服用時，少量點狀出血可能發生，請不要自行停藥。月經通常在後 7 顆無效錠期間來。若出血量持續增加、超過一週未停止，或無效錠期間沒有出血且曾漏吃藥，請驗孕或回診。
text.en: Light spotting may happen when you first start, so do not stop the pill on your own. Bleeding usually starts during the last 7 inactive tablets. If bleeding keeps getting heavier, lasts more than a week, or there is no bleeding during the inactive-tablet interval after missed tablets, take a pregnancy test or return to the doctor.

If bleeding keeps getting heavier, lasts more than a week, or there is no bleeding during the inactive-tablet interval after missed tablets, take a pregnancy test or return to the doctor.

If bleeding keeps getting heavier, lasts more than a week, or there is no bleeding during the inactive-tablet interval after missed tablets, take a pregnancy test or return to the doctor.

text.zh-TW: 胸痛、喘、單側小腿腫痛或突然視力模糊：停藥並立即就醫。
text.en: Chest pain, shortness of breath, one swollen painful calf, or sudden blurry vision: stop the pill and seek care now.
text.id: Nyeri dada, sesak napas, satu betis bengkak dan nyeri, atau penglihatan tiba-tiba kabur: hentikan pil dan segera cari pertolongan medis.
text.vi: Đau ngực, khó thở, một bên bắp chân sưng đau hoặc đột ngột mờ mắt: ngưng thuốc và đi khám ngay.
text.th: เจ็บหน้าอก หายใจลำบาก น่องข้างเดียวบวมเจ็บ หรือจู่ ๆ ตามัว: หยุดยาและพบแพทย์ทันที
text.tl: Pananakit ng dibdib, hingal, isang binti na namamaga at masakit, o biglang paglabo ng paningin: ihinto ang pills at magpatingin agad.
text.ja: 胸痛、息切れ、片側のふくらはぎの腫れや痛み、または急な視界のぼやけ：服用を中止し、直ちに受診してください。

text.zh-TW: 避孕藥不能預防性病；需要時仍要用保險套。
text.en: Birth control pills do not prevent STIs. Use condoms when needed.
text.id: Pil KB tidak mencegah infeksi menular seksual; gunakan kondom bila perlu.
text.vi: Thuốc tránh thai không phòng bệnh lây qua đường tình dục; dùng bao cao su khi cần.
text.th: ยาคุมกำเนิดไม่ป้องกันโรคติดต่อทางเพศสัมพันธ์ ควรใช้ถุงยางเมื่อจำเป็น
text.tl: Hindi pinipigilan ng birth control pills ang sexually transmitted infections; gumamit ng condom kung kailangan.
text.ja: 避妊薬は性感染症を予防できません。必要な時はコンドームを使ってください。

text.zh-TW: 前 1–3 個月身體適應時，可能會稍微容易出油或長小粉刺。
text.en: During the first 1 to 3 months, your body may be adjusting, so you may notice slightly more oiliness or small pimples.
text.id: Selama 1–3 bulan pertama saat tubuh sedang menyesuaikan diri, kulit bisa sedikit lebih berminyak atau muncul jerawat kecil.
text.vi: Trong 1–3 tháng đầu khi cơ thể đang thích nghi, da có thể hơi dễ đổ dầu hơn hoặc nổi các nốt mụn nhỏ.
text.th: ในช่วง 1–3 เดือนแรกที่ร่างกายกำลังปรับตัว อาจมีผิวมันขึ้นเล็กน้อยหรือมีสิวเม็ดเล็ก ๆ ได้บ้าง
text.tl: Sa unang 1–3 buwan habang nag-a-adjust pa ang katawan, maaaring medyo mas madaling mag-oily ang balat o magkaroon ng maliliit na pimples.
text.ja: 服用開始から1〜3か月ほどは体が慣れる過程で、やや皮脂が出やすくなったり、小さなにきびが出ることがあります。

title.th: Check the pack first

text.zh-TW: 這包前 21 顆是不同顏色的有效錠，後 7 顆是無效錠。請依箭頭與顏色順序吃。若吃錯順序，今天改吃正確的有效錠；接下來 7 天加用保險套。
text.en: The first 21 tablets are active tablets of different colors. The last 7 tablets are inactive. Follow the arrows and colors in order. If you took the wrong tablet first, switch to the correct active tablet today and use condoms for the next 7 days.

note.zh-TW: 想起時立刻補吃，下一顆照原時間吃；通常不需加用保險套。
note.en: Take it as soon as you remember, then take the next one at the usual time. Condoms are usually not needed.
note.id: Segera minum saat ingat, lalu minum tablet berikutnya pada waktu biasa. Biasanya tidak perlu kondom.
note.vi: Uống ngay khi nhớ ra, rồi uống viên tiếp theo vào giờ thường lệ. Thường không cần dùng bao cao su.
note.th: นึกได้ให้กินทันที แล้วกินเม็ดถัดไปตามเวลาเดิม โดยทั่วไปไม่ต้องใช้ถุงยางเพิ่ม
note.tl: Inumin agad kapag naalala, pagkatapos ay inumin ang susunod sa karaniwang oras. Karaniwang hindi kailangan ng condom.
note.ja: 気づいた時にすぐ飲み、次の錠剤は通常の時刻に飲みます。通常、コンドーム追加は不要です。

action.en: If tablets are missed in weeks 1 to 2
action.id: Jika ada tablet yang terlupa pada minggu 1 sampai ke-2
action.vi: Nếu quên thuốc trong tuần 1 đến tuần 2
action.th: หากลืมยาในสัปดาห์ที่ 1–2
action.tl: Kung may nakalimutang tableta sa linggo 1 hanggang 2
action.ja: 1〜2週目に飲み忘れた場合

note.zh-TW: 補最近漏的 1 顆，今天該吃的也照吃。其他漏掉的丟棄；接下來 7 天加用保險套。
note.en: Take the most recent missed tablet and take today's tablet as usual. Discard the other missed tablets. Use condoms for the next 7 days.
note.id: Minum tablet yang paling baru terlupa dan tablet hari ini seperti biasa. Buang tablet lain yang terlupa; gunakan kondom 7 hari.
note.vi: Uống viên quên gần nhất và viên của hôm nay như thường lệ. Bỏ các viên quên khác; dùng bao cao su trong 7 ngày.
note.th: กินเม็ดที่ลืมล่าสุดและเม็ดของวันนี้ตามปกติ ทิ้งเม็ดที่ลืมอื่น ๆ และใช้ถุงยาง 7 วัน
note.tl: Inumin ang pinakahuling nakalimutan at ang tableta para sa araw na ito gaya ng dati. Itapon ang iba pang nakalimutan; gumamit ng condom sa loob ng 7 araw.
note.ja: 直近で飲み忘れた1錠と今日の分を飲みます。ほかの飲み忘れ錠は捨て、7日間はコンドームを使ってください。

action.en: If tablets are missed in week 3
action.id: Jika ada tablet yang terlupa pada minggu ke-3
action.vi: Nếu quên thuốc trong tuần 3
action.th: หากลืมยาในสัปดาห์ที่ 3
action.tl: Kung may nakalimutang tableta sa linggo 3
action.ja: 3週目に飲み忘れた場合

note.zh-TW: 補最近漏的 1 顆，吃完剩下有效錠後，丟掉後 7 顆無效錠，隔天直接開新包；接下來 7 天加用保險套。
note.en: Take the most recent missed tablet. Finish the remaining active tablets, discard the last 7 inactive tablets, and start a new pack the next day. Use condoms for the next 7 days.
note.id: Minum tablet yang paling baru terlupa. Habiskan tablet aktif, buang 7 tablet tidak aktif terakhir, lalu mulai kemasan baru keesokan harinya. Gunakan kondom 7 hari.
note.vi: Uống viên quên gần nhất. Uống hết viên có hoạt chất, bỏ 7 viên không hoạt chất cuối rồi hôm sau bắt đầu vỉ mới. Dùng bao cao su 7 ngày.
note.th: กินเม็ดที่ลืมล่าสุด กินเม็ดที่มีตัวยาจนหมด ทิ้ง 7 เม็ดหลังที่ไม่มีตัวยา แล้วเริ่มแผงใหม่วันถัดไป ใช้ถุงยาง 7 วัน
note.tl: Inumin ang pinakahuling nakalimutan. Tapusin ang aktibong tableta, itapon ang huling 7 hindi aktibo, at magsimula ng bagong pakete kinabukasan. Gumamit ng condom 7 araw.
note.ja: 直近で飲み忘れた1錠を飲み、有効錠を飲み切ります。最後の7錠の無効錠は捨て、翌日に新しいシートを始め、7日間コンドームを使ってください。

title.th: Vomiting or severe diarrhea

text.zh-TW: 吃有效錠後 3～4 小時內嘔吐，或有嚴重腹瀉時，藥可能沒有吸收完全。請當作漏吃有效錠處理；若需要補 1 顆，可從另一包拿 1 顆補。
text.en: If you vomit within 3 to 4 hours after an active tablet, or if you have severe diarrhea, the pill may not be fully absorbed. Treat this like a missed active tablet. If you need one extra tablet, take it from another pack.

title.th: Bleeding changes

text.zh-TW: 剛開始服用時，少量點狀出血可能發生，請不要自行停藥。月經通常在後 7 顆無效錠期間來。若出血量持續增加、超過一週未停止，或無效錠期間沒有出血且曾漏吃藥，請驗孕或回診。
text.en: Light spotting may happen when you first start, so do not stop the pill on your own. Bleeding usually starts during the last 7 inactive tablets. If bleeding keeps getting heavier, lasts more than a week, or there is no bleeding during the inactive-tablet interval after missed tablets, take a pregnancy test or return to the doctor.

text.zh-TW: 胸痛、喘、單側小腿腫痛或突然視力模糊：停藥並立即就醫。
text.en: Chest pain, shortness of breath, one swollen painful calf, or sudden blurry vision: stop the pill and seek care now.
text.id: Nyeri dada, sesak napas, satu betis bengkak dan nyeri, atau penglihatan tiba-tiba kabur: hentikan pil dan segera cari pertolongan medis.
text.vi: Đau ngực, khó thở, một bên bắp chân sưng đau hoặc đột ngột mờ mắt: ngưng thuốc và đi khám ngay.
text.th: เจ็บหน้าอก หายใจลำบาก น่องข้างเดียวบวมเจ็บ หรือจู่ ๆ ตามัว: หยุดยาและพบแพทย์ทันที
text.tl: Pananakit ng dibdib, hingal, isang binti na namamaga at masakit, o biglang paglabo ng paningin: ihinto ang pills at magpatingin agad.
text.ja: 胸痛、息切れ、片側のふくらはぎの腫れや痛み、または急な視界のぼやけ：服用を中止し、直ちに受診してください。

text.zh-TW: 避孕藥不能預防性病；需要時仍要用保險套。
text.en: Birth control pills do not prevent STIs. Use condoms when needed.
text.id: Pil KB tidak mencegah infeksi menular seksual; gunakan kondom bila perlu.
text.vi: Thuốc tránh thai không phòng bệnh lây qua đường tình dục; dùng bao cao su khi cần.
text.th: ยาคุมกำเนิดไม่ป้องกันโรคติดต่อทางเพศสัมพันธ์ ควรใช้ถุงยางเมื่อจำเป็น
text.tl: Hindi pinipigilan ng birth control pills ang sexually transmitted infections; gumamit ng condom kung kailangan.
text.ja: 避妊薬は性感染症を予防できません。必要な時はコンドームを使ってください。

text.zh-TW: 前 1–3 個月身體適應時，可能會稍微容易出油或長小粉刺。
text.en: During the first 1 to 3 months, your body may be adjusting, so you may notice slightly more oiliness or small pimples.
text.id: Selama 1–3 bulan pertama saat tubuh sedang menyesuaikan diri, kulit bisa sedikit lebih berminyak atau muncul jerawat kecil.
text.vi: Trong 1–3 tháng đầu khi cơ thể đang thích nghi, da có thể hơi dễ đổ dầu hơn hoặc nổi các nốt mụn nhỏ.
text.th: ในช่วง 1–3 เดือนแรกที่ร่างกายกำลังปรับตัว อาจมีผิวมันขึ้นเล็กน้อยหรือมีสิวเม็ดเล็ก ๆ ได้บ้าง
text.tl: Sa unang 1–3 buwan habang nag-a-adjust pa ang katawan, maaaring medyo mas madaling mag-oily ang balat o magkaroon ng maliliit na pimples.
text.ja: 服用開始から1〜3か月ほどは体が慣れる過程で、やや皮脂が出やすくなったり、小さなにきびが出ることがあります。

title.th: Check the pack first

text.zh-TW: 這包 21 顆都是有效錠。吃完後要停藥 7 天，再開新包。
text.en: All 21 tablets in this pack are active. After finishing the pack, take a 7-day break before starting a new pack.

action.zh-TW: 月經第 1～5 天開始吃第 1 顆有效錠
action.en: Start the first active tablet on menstrual day 1 to 5
action.id: Mulai tablet aktif pertama pada hari haid ke-1 sampai ke-5
action.vi: Bắt đầu viên có hoạt chất đầu tiên vào ngày 1 đến ngày 5 của kỳ kinh
action.th: เริ่มกินเม็ดยาที่มีตัวยาเม็ดแรกในวันที่ 1–5 ของประจำเดือน
action.tl: Simulan ang unang aktibong tableta sa araw 1 hanggang 5 ng regla
action.ja: 月経1〜5日目に最初の有効錠を飲む

note.zh-TW: 搭配白開水整顆吞服。若不是第 1 天開始，前 7 天加用保險套。
note.en: Swallow it whole with water. If you do not start on day 1, use condoms for the first 7 days.
note.id: Telan utuh dengan air putih. Jika tidak mulai pada hari ke-1, gunakan kondom selama 7 hari pertama.
note.vi: Nuốt nguyên viên với nước lọc. Nếu không bắt đầu vào ngày 1, dùng bao cao su trong 7 ngày đầu.
note.th: กลืนทั้งเม็ดกับน้ำเปล่า หากไม่ได้เริ่มวันที่ 1 ให้ใช้ถุงยางใน 7 วันแรก
note.tl: Lunukin nang buo kasama ng tubig. Kung hindi nagsimula sa araw 1, gumamit ng condom sa unang 7 araw.
note.ja: 水で錠剤をそのまま飲みます。1日目以外に開始した場合、最初の7日間はコンドームを使ってください。

action.zh-TW: 每天固定時間吃 1 顆
action.en: Take 1 tablet at the same time each day
action.id: Minum 1 tablet pada waktu yang sama setiap hari
action.vi: Uống 1 viên vào cùng một giờ mỗi ngày
action.th: กินวันละ 1 เม็ด เวลาเดิมทุกวัน
action.tl: Uminom ng 1 tableta sa parehong oras araw-araw
action.ja: 毎日同じ時刻に1錠飲む

note.zh-TW: 依包裝順序連續吃 21 天。
note.en: Follow the pack order for 21 straight days.
note.id: Ikuti urutan pada kemasan selama 21 hari berturut-turut.
note.vi: Uống theo thứ tự trên vỉ trong 21 ngày liên tiếp.
note.th: กินตามลำดับบนแผงยา ติดต่อกัน 21 วัน
note.tl: Sundin ang pagkakasunod sa pakete sa loob ng 21 magkakasunod na araw.
note.ja: シートの順番どおりに21日間続けて飲みます。

action.zh-TW: 吃完 21 顆後停藥 7 天
action.en: After 21 tablets, take a 7-day break
action.id: Setelah 21 tablet, berhenti 7 hari
action.vi: Sau 21 viên, nghỉ thuốc 7 ngày
action.th: กินครบ 21 เม็ดแล้ว หยุดยา 7 วัน
action.tl: Pagkatapos ng 21 tableta, magpahinga ng 7 araw
action.ja: 21錠を飲み終えたら7日間休薬する

note.zh-TW: 停藥期間不吃藥；月經通常在第 2～3 天來。第 8 天開新包。
note.en: Take no tablets during the break. Bleeding usually starts on day 2 or 3. Start the new pack on day 8.
note.id: Jangan minum tablet selama masa jeda. Perdarahan biasanya mulai hari ke-2 atau ke-3. Mulai kemasan baru pada hari ke-8.
note.vi: Không uống thuốc trong thời gian nghỉ. Ra máu thường bắt đầu vào ngày 2 hoặc 3. Bắt đầu vỉ mới vào ngày 8.
note.th: ช่วงหยุดยาไม่ต้องกินเม็ดใด เลือดมักมาในวันที่ 2–3 และเริ่มแผงใหม่วันที่ 8
note.tl: Huwag uminom ng tableta sa pahinga. Karaniwang nagsisimula ang pagdurugo sa araw 2 o 3. Magsimula ng bagong pakete sa araw 8.
note.ja: 休薬中は飲みません。出血は通常2〜3日目に始まります。8日目に新しいシートを開始します。

note.th: กินเม็ดที่ลืมล่าสุด กินเม็ดที่มีตัวยาที่เหลือให้หมด แล้วเริ่มแผงใหม่วันถัดไปโดยข้ามช่วงหยุด 7 วัน ใช้ถุงยาง 7 วัน
note.tl: Inumin ang pinakahuling nakalimutan. Tapusin ang natitirang aktibong tableta, magsimula ng bagong pakete kinabukasan at laktawan ang 7 araw na pahinga. Gumamit ng condom 7 araw.
note.ja: 直近で飲み忘れた1錠を飲み、残りの有効錠を飲み切ります。翌日に新しいシートを始めて7日間の休薬を飛ばし、7日間コンドームを使ってください。

title.th: Vomiting or severe diarrhea

text.zh-TW: 吃有效錠後 3～4 小時內嘔吐，或有嚴重腹瀉時，藥可能沒有吸收完全。請當作漏吃有效錠處理；若需要補 1 顆，可從另一包拿 1 顆補。
text.en: If you vomit within 3 to 4 hours after an active tablet, or if you have severe diarrhea, the pill may not be fully absorbed. Treat this like a missed active tablet. If you need one extra tablet, take it from another pack.
text.id: If you vomit within 3 to 4 hours after an active tablet, or if you have severe diarrhea, the pill may not be fully absorbed. Treat this like a missed active tablet. If you need one extra tablet, take it from another pack.
text.vi: If you vomit within 3 to 4 hours after an active tablet, or if you have severe diarrhea, the pill may not be fully absorbed. Treat this like a missed active tablet. If you need one extra tablet, take it from another pack.
text.th: If you vomit within 3 to 4 hours after an active tablet, or if you have severe diarrhea, the pill may not be fully absorbed. Treat this like a missed active tablet. If you need one extra tablet, take it from another pack.
text.tl: If you vomit within 3 to 4 hours after an active tablet, or if you have severe diarrhea, the pill may not be fully absorbed. Treat this like a missed active tablet. If you need one extra tablet, take it from another pack.
text.ja: If you vomit within 3 to 4 hours after an active tablet, or if you have severe diarrhea, the pill may not be fully absorbed. Treat this like a missed active tablet. If you need one extra tablet, take it from another pack.

title.th: Bleeding changes

text.zh-TW: 剛開始服用時，少量點狀出血可能發生，請不要自行停藥。停藥 7 天時，月經通常在第 2～3 天來。若出血量持續增加、超過一週未停止，或停藥期間沒有出血且曾漏吃藥，請驗孕或回診。
text.en: Light spotting may happen when you first start, so do not stop the pill on your own. During the 7-day break, bleeding usually starts on day 2 or 3. If bleeding keeps getting heavier, lasts more than a week, or there is no bleeding during the break after missed tablets, take a pregnancy test or return to the doctor.
text.id: Light spotting may happen when you first start, so do not stop the pill on your own. During the 7-day break, bleeding usually starts on day 2 or 3. If bleeding keeps getting heavier, lasts more than a week, or there is no bleeding during the break after missed tablets, take a pregnancy test or return to the doctor.
text.vi: Light spotting may happen when you first start, so do not stop the pill on your own. During the 7-day break, bleeding usually starts on day 2 or 3. If bleeding keeps getting heavier, lasts more than a week, or there is no bleeding during the break after missed tablets, take a pregnancy test or return to the doctor.

If bleeding keeps getting heavier, lasts more than a week, or there is no bleeding during the break after missed tablets, take a pregnancy test or return to the doctor.
text.tl: Light spotting may happen when you first start, so do not stop the pill on your own. During the 7-day break, bleeding usually starts on day 2 or 3. If bleeding keeps getting heavier, lasts more than a week, or there is no bleeding during the break after missed tablets, take a pregnancy test or return to the doctor.
text.ja: Light spotting may happen when you first start, so do not stop the pill on your own. During the 7-day break, bleeding usually starts on day 2 or 3. If bleeding keeps getting heavier, lasts more than a week, or there is no bleeding during the break after missed tablets, take a pregnancy test or return to the doctor.

text.zh-TW: 胸痛、喘、單側小腿腫痛或突然視力模糊：停藥並立即就醫。
text.en: Chest pain, shortness of breath, one swollen painful calf, or sudden blurry vision: stop the pill and seek care now.
text.id: Nyeri dada, sesak napas, satu betis bengkak dan nyeri, atau penglihatan tiba-tiba kabur: hentikan pil dan segera cari pertolongan medis.
text.vi: Đau ngực, khó thở, một bên bắp chân sưng đau hoặc đột ngột mờ mắt: ngưng thuốc và đi khám ngay.
text.th: เจ็บหน้าอก หายใจลำบาก น่องข้างเดียวบวมเจ็บ หรือจู่ ๆ ตามัว: หยุดยาและพบแพทย์ทันที
text.tl: Pananakit ng dibdib, hingal, isang binti na namamaga at masakit, o biglang paglabo ng paningin: ihinto ang pills at magpatingin agad.
text.ja: 胸痛、息切れ、片側のふくらはぎの腫れや痛み、または急な視界のぼやけ：服用を中止し、直ちに受診してください。

text.zh-TW: 避孕藥不能預防性病；需要時仍要用保險套。
text.en: Birth control pills do not prevent STIs. Use condoms when needed.
text.id: Pil KB tidak mencegah infeksi menular seksual; gunakan kondom bila perlu.
text.vi: Thuốc tránh thai không phòng bệnh lây qua đường tình dục; dùng bao cao su khi cần.
text.th: ยาคุมกำเนิดไม่ป้องกันโรคติดต่อทางเพศสัมพันธ์ ควรใช้ถุงยางเมื่อจำเป็น
text.tl: Hindi pinipigilan ng birth control pills ang sexually transmitted infections; gumamit ng condom kung kailangan.
text.ja: 避妊薬は性感染症を予防できません。必要な時はコンドームを使ってください。

text.zh-TW: 前 1–3 個月身體適應時，可能會稍微容易出油或長小粉刺。
text.en: During the first 1 to 3 months, your body may be adjusting, so you may notice slightly more oiliness or small pimples.
text.id: Selama 1–3 bulan pertama saat tubuh sedang menyesuaikan diri, kulit bisa sedikit lebih berminyak atau muncul jerawat kecil.
text.vi: Trong 1–3 tháng đầu khi cơ thể đang thích nghi, da có thể hơi dễ đổ dầu hơn hoặc nổi các nốt mụn nhỏ.
text.th: ในช่วง 1–3 เดือนแรกที่ร่างกายกำลังปรับตัว อาจมีผิวมันขึ้นเล็กน้อยหรือมีสิวเม็ดเล็ก ๆ ได้บ้าง
text.tl: Sa unang 1–3 buwan habang nag-a-adjust pa ang katawan, maaaring medyo mas madaling mag-oily ang balat o magkaroon ng maliliit na pimples.
text.ja: 服用開始から1〜3か月ほどは体が慣れる過程で、やや皮脂が出やすくなったり、小さなにきびが出ることがあります。

title.th: ดูกล่อง/แผงยาก่อน

text.zh-TW: 這包 21 顆都是含荷爾蒙的有效錠。吃完 21 顆後停藥 7 天，第 8 天開新包。
text.en: All 21 tablets in this pack contain hormones. After 21 tablets, take a 7-day break and start a new pack on day 8.
text.id: Semua 21 tablet dalam kemasan ini adalah tablet aktif yang mengandung hormon. Setelah 21 tablet habis, berhenti 7 hari lalu mulai kemasan baru pada hari ke-8.
text.vi: Cả 21 viên trong vỉ này đều là viên có hormone. Sau khi uống hết 21 viên, nghỉ 7 ngày rồi bắt đầu vỉ mới vào ngày thứ 8.
text.th: ยา 21 เม็ดในแผงนี้เป็นเม็ดที่มีฮอร์โมนทั้งหมด เมื่อกินครบ 21 เม็ด ให้หยุดยา 7 วัน แล้วเริ่มแผงใหม่ในวันที่ 8
text.tl: Lahat ng 21 tableta sa paketeng ito ay may hormone. Pagkatapos ng 21 tableta, magpahinga ng 7 araw at magsimula ng bagong pakete sa ika-8 araw.
text.ja: このシートの21錠はすべてホルモンを含む有効錠です。21錠を飲み終えたら7日間休薬し、8日目に新しいシートを始めます。

action.zh-TW: 月經第 1 天開始吃第 1 顆
action.en: Start the first tablet on menstrual day 1
action.id: Mulai tablet pertama pada hari pertama haid
action.vi: Bắt đầu viên đầu tiên vào ngày 1 của kỳ kinh
action.th: เริ่มเม็ดแรกในวันแรกของประจำเดือน
action.tl: Simulan ang unang tableta sa unang araw ng regla
action.ja: 月経1日目に1錠目を飲み始める

note.zh-TW: 搭配白開水整顆吞服。若第 2～5 天才開始，前 7 天加用保險套。
note.en: Swallow it whole with water. If you start on days 2 to 5, use condoms for the first 7 days.
note.id: Telan utuh dengan air putih. Jika baru mulai pada hari ke-2 sampai ke-5, gunakan kondom selama 7 hari pertama.
note.vi: Nuốt nguyên viên với nước lọc. Nếu bắt đầu vào ngày 2–5, dùng bao cao su trong 7 ngày đầu.
note.th: กลืนทั้งเม็ดกับน้ำเปล่า หากเริ่มวันที่ 2–5 ให้ใช้ถุงยางใน 7 วันแรก
note.tl: Lunukin nang buo kasama ng tubig. Kung nagsimula sa araw 2 hanggang 5, gumamit ng condom sa unang 7 araw.
note.ja: 水で錠剤をそのまま飲みます。2〜5日目に始める場合、最初の7日間はコンドームを併用してください。

action.zh-TW: 每天固定時間吃 1 顆
action.en: Take 1 tablet at the same time each day
action.id: Minum 1 tablet pada waktu yang sama setiap hari
action.vi: Uống 1 viên vào cùng một giờ mỗi ngày
action.th: กินวันละ 1 เม็ด เวลาเดิมทุกวัน
action.tl: Uminom ng 1 tableta sa parehong oras araw-araw
action.ja: 毎日同じ時刻に1錠飲む

note.zh-TW: 依包裝順序吃，連續吃 21 天。不要跳著吃，也不要自行停藥。
note.en: Follow the pack order for 21 days. Do not skip around or stop on your own.
note.id: Ikuti urutan pada kemasan dan minum selama 21 hari berturut-turut. Jangan melompati urutan dan jangan berhenti sendiri.
note.vi: Uống theo thứ tự trên vỉ trong 21 ngày liên tục. Không uống nhảy viên và không tự ý ngưng thuốc.
note.th: กินตามลำดับบนแผงยา ติดต่อกัน 21 วัน อย่ากินข้ามลำดับ และอย่าหยุดยาเอง
note.tl: Sundin ang pagkakasunod sa pakete sa loob ng 21 araw. Huwag laktawan ang pagkakasunod at huwag ihinto nang sarili.
note.ja: シートの順番どおりに21日間続けて飲みます。順番を飛ばしたり、自己判断で中止したりしないでください。

action.zh-TW: 吃完 21 顆後停藥 7 天
action.en: After 21 tablets, take a 7-day break
action.id: Setelah 21 tablet habis, berhenti 7 hari
action.vi: Sau khi uống hết 21 viên, nghỉ thuốc 7 ngày
action.th: กินครบ 21 เม็ดแล้ว หยุดยา 7 วัน
action.tl: Pagkatapos ng 21 tableta, magpahinga ng 7 araw
action.ja: 21錠を飲み終えたら7日間休薬する

note.zh-TW: 停藥期間不吃藥。通常停藥後第 2～3 天會出血。
note.en: Take no tablets during the break. Bleeding usually starts 2 to 3 days after stopping.
note.id: Selama jeda, jangan minum tablet. Perdarahan biasanya mulai 2–3 hari setelah berhenti.
note.vi: Trong thời gian nghỉ, không uống thuốc. Máu thường ra vào ngày 2–3 sau khi ngưng.
note.th: ช่วงหยุดยาไม่ต้องกินยา โดยทั่วไปเลือดจะออกประมาณวันที่ 2–3 หลังหยุดยา
note.tl: Sa panahon ng pahinga, huwag uminom ng tableta. Karaniwang nagsisimula ang pagdurugo 2–3 araw matapos huminto.
note.ja: 休薬中は錠剤を飲みません。通常、休薬後2〜3日ごろに出血が始まります。

action.en: Start a new pack on day 8
action.id: Mulai kemasan baru pada hari ke-8
action.vi: Ngày thứ 8 bắt đầu vỉ mới
action.th: วันที่ 8 เริ่มแผงใหม่
action.tl: Sa ika-8 araw, magsimula ng bagong pakete
action.ja: 8日目に新しいシートを始める

note.zh-TW: 即使出血還沒結束，也要照時間開新包。
note.en: Start the new pack on schedule, even if bleeding has not stopped.
note.id: Mulai kemasan baru sesuai jadwal, meskipun perdarahan belum berhenti.
note.vi: Bắt đầu vỉ mới đúng lịch, dù máu vẫn chưa hết.
note.th: เริ่มแผงใหม่ตามกำหนด แม้เลือดยังไม่หยุด
note.tl: Simulan ang bagong pakete ayon sa iskedyul, kahit hindi pa tapos ang pagdurugo.
note.ja: 出血が終わっていなくても、予定どおり新しいシートを始めてください。

action.en: If a tablet is missed in weeks 1 to 2
action.id: Jika lupa tablet pada minggu ke-1 sampai ke-2
action.vi: Nếu quên thuốc trong tuần 1–2
action.th: หากลืมยาในสัปดาห์ที่ 1–2
action.tl: Kung may nakalimutang tableta sa linggo 1–2
action.ja: 1〜2週目に飲み忘れた場合

note.zh-TW: 第 1 週：12 小時內想起，立刻補吃；超過 12 小時，補最近漏的 1 顆，接下來 7 天加用保險套。第 2 週：若前 7 天都有正確吃藥，補吃後照常吃；若前 7 天也曾漏吃，或這次漏吃超過 1 顆，接下來 7 天加用保險套。
note.en: Week 1: if remembered within 12 hours, take it right away. If more than 12 hours late, take the most recent missed tablet and use condoms for the next 7 days. Week 2: if the previous 7 days were taken correctly, take the missed tablet and continue as usual. If any tablets were missed in the previous 7 days, or if more than 1 tablet was missed this time, use condoms for the next 7 days.
note.id: Minggu 1: jika ingat dalam 12 jam, segera minum. Jika lewat 12 jam, minum 1 tablet yang paling baru terlupa dan gunakan kondom selama 7 hari berikutnya. Minggu 2: jika 7 hari sebelumnya diminum dengan benar, minum tablet yang terlupa lalu lanjutkan seperti biasa. Jika dalam 7 hari sebelumnya juga ada yang terlupa, atau kali ini lupa lebih dari 1 tablet, gunakan kondom selama 7 hari berikutnya.
note.vi: Tuần 1: nếu nhớ ra trong vòng 12 giờ, uống bù ngay. Nếu trễ hơn 12 giờ, uống viên quên gần nhất và dùng bao cao su trong 7 ngày tiếp theo. Tuần 2: nếu 7 ngày trước đó đều uống đúng, uống bù rồi tiếp tục như thường lệ. Nếu 7 ngày trước đó cũng từng quên, hoặc lần này quên hơn 1 viên, dùng bao cao su trong 7 ngày tiếp theo.
note.th: สัปดาห์ที่ 1: หากนึกได้ภายใน 12 ชั่วโมง ให้กินทันที หากเกิน 12 ชั่วโมง ให้กินเม็ดที่ลืมล่าสุด 1 เม็ด และใช้ถุงยางใน 7 วันถัดไป สัปดาห์ที่ 2: หาก 7 วันก่อนหน้านี้กินถูกต้อง ให้กินเม็ดที่ลืมแล้วกินต่อเหมือนเดิม หาก 7 วันก่อนหน้านี้เคยลืม หรือครั้งนี้ลืมมากกว่า 1 เม็ด ให้ใช้ถุงยางใน 7 วันถัดไป
note.tl: Linggo 1: kung naalala sa loob ng 12 oras, inumin agad. Kung higit sa 12 oras na, inumin ang pinakahuling nakalimutang tableta at gumamit ng condom sa susunod na 7 araw. Linggo 2: kung tama ang pag-inom sa nakaraang 7 araw, inumin ang nakalimutang tableta at ituloy tulad ng dati. Kung may nakalimutan din sa nakaraang 7 araw, o higit sa 1 tableta ang nakalimutan ngayon, gumamit ng condom sa susunod na 7 araw.
note.ja: 1週目：12時間以内に気づいたらすぐ飲みます。12時間を超えた場合は、直近で飲み忘れた1錠を飲み、今後7日間はコンドームを併用してください。2週目：直前7日間を正しく飲めていた場合は、飲み忘れ分を飲んで通常どおり続けます。直前7日間にも飲み忘れがあった場合、または今回2錠以上飲み忘れた場合は、今後7日間はコンドームを併用してください。

action.en: If a tablet is missed in week 3
action.id: Jika lupa tablet pada minggu ke-3
action.vi: Nếu quên thuốc trong tuần 3
action.th: หากลืมยาในสัปดาห์ที่ 3
action.tl: Kung may nakalimutang tableta sa linggo 3
action.ja: 3週目に飲み忘れた場合

note.zh-TW: 補最近漏的 1 顆，照常吃完本包。隔天直接開新包，不停藥 7 天；若前 7 天也曾漏吃，接下來 7 天加用保險套。
note.en: Take the most recent missed tablet and finish the rest of this pack. Start a new pack the next day and skip the 7-day break. If tablets were also missed in the previous 7 days, use condoms for the next 7 days.
note.id: Minum tablet yang paling baru terlupa lalu habiskan sisa tablet dalam kemasan ini. Mulai kemasan baru keesokan harinya dan jangan jeda 7 hari. Jika dalam 7 hari sebelumnya juga ada tablet yang terlupa, gunakan kondom selama 7 hari berikutnya.
note.vi: Uống viên quên gần nhất rồi uống hết phần còn lại của vỉ này. Hôm sau bắt đầu vỉ mới, không nghỉ 7 ngày. Nếu trong 7 ngày trước đó cũng từng quên thuốc, dùng bao cao su trong 7 ngày tiếp theo.
note.th: กินเม็ดที่ลืมล่าสุด แล้วกินยาที่เหลือในแผงนี้ให้หมด วันถัดไปเริ่มแผงใหม่ทันที ไม่ต้องหยุดยา 7 วัน หากใน 7 วันก่อนหน้านี้ก็เคยลืมยา ให้ใช้ถุงยางใน 7 วันถัดไป
note.tl: Inumin ang pinakahuling nakalimutang tableta at tapusin ang natitirang tableta sa paketeng ito. Magsimula ng bagong pakete kinabukasan at huwag magpahinga ng 7 araw. Kung may nakalimutang tableta rin sa nakaraang 7 araw, gumamit ng condom sa susunod na 7 araw.
note.ja: 直近で飲み忘れた1錠を飲み、このシートの残りを飲み切ります。翌日に新しいシートを始め、7日間の休薬はしません。前の7日間にも飲み忘れがあった場合は、今後7日間コンドームを併用してください。

title.vi: Nôn ói hoặc tiêu chảy nặng
title.th: อาเจียนหรือท้องเสียรุนแรง

text.zh-TW: 吃藥後 3–4 小時內嘔吐，或有嚴重腹瀉，藥可能沒有吸收完全。請當作漏吃處理；若需要補 1 顆，可從另一包拿 1 顆補。
text.en: If you vomit within 3 to 4 hours after a tablet, or have severe diarrhea, the pill may not have been fully absorbed. Treat it as a missed tablet. If you need 1 extra tablet, take it from another pack.
text.id: Jika Anda muntah dalam 3-4 jam setelah minum tablet, atau mengalami diare berat, pil mungkin belum terserap sempurna. Perlakukan ini seperti tablet yang terlupa. Jika perlu menambah 1 tablet, ambil 1 tablet dari kemasan lain.
text.vi: Nếu bạn nôn trong vòng 3-4 giờ sau khi uống thuốc, hoặc bị tiêu chảy nặng, thuốc có thể chưa được hấp thu hoàn toàn. Hãy xử lý như quên thuốc. Nếu cần bù 1 viên, lấy 1 viên từ vỉ khác để uống bù.
text.th: หากอาเจียนภายใน 3-4 ชั่วโมงหลังรับประทานยา หรือมีอาการท้องเสียรุนแรง ยาอาจยังดูดซึมไม่ครบ ให้ถือว่าเหมือนลืมยา หากต้องกินเพิ่ม 1 เม็ด ให้หยิบจากอีกแผงมาชดเชย 1 เม็ด
text.tl: Kung sumuka ka sa loob ng 3-4 oras matapos uminom ng tableta, o nagkaroon ng matinding pagtatae, maaaring hindi pa ganap na nasipsip ang gamot. Ituring ito na parang nakalimutang tableta. Kung kailangan ng dagdag na 1 tableta, kumuha ng 1 mula sa ibang pakete.
text.ja: 服用後3〜4時間以内に嘔吐した場合、または重い下痢がある場合は、薬が十分に吸収されていない可能性があります。飲み忘れとして対応してください。1錠補う必要がある場合は、別のシートから1錠取って補ってください。

title.th: การเปลี่ยนแปลงของเลือดออก

text.zh-TW: 剛開始服用時，少量點狀出血可能發生，請不要自行停藥。停藥 7 天時，月經通常在第 2～3 天來。若出血量持續增加、超過一週未停止，或停藥期間沒有出血且曾漏吃藥，請驗孕或回診。
text.en: Light spotting may happen when you first start, so do not stop the pill on your own. During the 7-day break, bleeding usually starts on day 2 or 3. If bleeding keeps getting heavier, lasts more than a week, or there is no bleeding during the break after missed tablets, take a pregnancy test or return to the doctor.
text.id: Saat baru mulai minum, bercak darah ringan bisa terjadi. Jangan menghentikan pil sendiri. Saat jeda 7 hari, perdarahan biasanya mulai pada hari ke-2 atau ke-3. Jika darah makin banyak, tidak berhenti lebih dari 1 minggu, atau tidak ada perdarahan saat jeda setelah pernah lupa minum tablet, lakukan tes kehamilan atau kembali ke dokter.
text.vi: Khi mới bắt đầu dùng thuốc, có thể xuất hiện ra huyết lấm tấm ít; đừng tự ý ngưng thuốc. Trong 7 ngày nghỉ thuốc, máu thường ra vào ngày 2 hoặc 3. Nếu lượng máu ra tăng dần, kéo dài quá 1 tuần, hoặc không ra máu trong kỳ nghỉ thuốc sau khi từng quên thuốc, hãy thử thai hoặc đi khám lại.
text.th: เมื่อเริ่มใช้ยาใหม่ ๆ อาจมีเลือดกะปริบกะปรอยเล็กน้อยได้ อย่าหยุดยาเอง ช่วงหยุดยา 7 วัน เลือดมักมาประมาณวันที่ 2 หรือ 3 หากเลือดออกมากขึ้นเรื่อย ๆ นานเกิน 1 สัปดาห์ หรือไม่มีเลือดออกในช่วงหยุดยาหลังจากเคยลืมยา ให้ตรวจการตั้งครรภ์หรือกลับไปพบแพทย์
text.tl: Sa simula ng pag-inom, maaaring magkaroon ng kaunting spotting. Huwag itigil ang pills nang mag-isa. Sa 7 araw na pahinga, karaniwang nagsisimula ang pagdurugo sa araw 2 o 3. Kung patuloy na lumalakas ang pagdurugo, tumatagal nang mahigit 1 linggo, o walang pagdurugo sa panahon ng pahinga matapos may nakalimutang tableta, mag-pregnancy test o magpatingin muli.
text.ja: 飲み始めには少量の不正出血が起こることがあります。自己判断で中止しないでください。7日間の休薬中の出血は、通常2日目または3日目ごろに始まります。出血量が増え続ける、1週間を超えて止まらない、または飲み忘れ後の休薬中に出血がない場合は、妊娠検査をするか受診してください。

text.zh-TW: 胸痛、喘、單側小腿腫痛或突然視力模糊：停藥並立即就醫。
text.en: Chest pain, shortness of breath, one swollen painful calf, or sudden blurry vision: stop the pill and seek care now.
text.id: Nyeri dada, sesak napas, satu betis bengkak dan nyeri, atau penglihatan tiba-tiba kabur: hentikan pil dan segera cari pertolongan medis.
text.vi: Đau ngực, khó thở, một bên bắp chân sưng đau hoặc đột ngột mờ mắt: ngưng thuốc và đi khám ngay.
text.th: เจ็บหน้าอก หายใจลำบาก น่องข้างเดียวบวมเจ็บ หรือจู่ ๆ ตามัว: หยุดยาและพบแพทย์ทันที
text.tl: Pananakit ng dibdib, hingal, isang binti na namamaga at masakit, o biglang paglabo ng paningin: ihinto ang pills at magpatingin agad.
text.ja: 胸痛、息切れ、片側のふくらはぎの腫れや痛み、または急な視界のぼやけ：服用を中止し、直ちに受診してください。

text.zh-TW: 避孕藥不能預防性病；需要時仍要用保險套。
text.en: Birth control pills do not prevent STIs. Use condoms when needed.
text.id: Pil KB tidak mencegah infeksi menular seksual; gunakan kondom bila perlu.
text.vi: Thuốc tránh thai không phòng bệnh lây qua đường tình dục; dùng bao cao su khi cần.
text.th: ยาคุมกำเนิดไม่ป้องกันโรคติดต่อทางเพศสัมพันธ์ ควรใช้ถุงยางเมื่อจำเป็น
text.tl: Hindi pinipigilan ng birth control pills ang sexually transmitted infections; gumamit ng condom kung kailangan.
text.ja: 避妊薬は性感染症を予防できません。必要な時はコンドームを使ってください。

text.zh-TW: 若要手術或長時間臥床，或有其他處方藥、成藥與保健品，請先告知醫師或藥師目前正在吃避孕藥。
text.en: If you will have surgery, need long bed rest, or use any prescription medicines, over-the-counter medicines, or supplements, tell your doctor or pharmacist that you are taking birth control pills.
text.id: Jika Anda akan menjalani operasi, harus tirah baring lama, atau menggunakan obat resep, obat bebas, atau suplemen lain, beri tahu dokter atau apoteker bahwa Anda sedang minum pil KB.
text.vi: Nếu bạn sắp phẫu thuật, phải nằm bất động lâu, hoặc đang dùng thuốc kê đơn, thuốc không kê đơn hay thực phẩm bổ sung khác, hãy báo cho bác sĩ hoặc dược sĩ biết bạn đang dùng thuốc tránh thai.
text.th: หากต้องผ่าตัด ต้องนอนพักนาน ๆ หรือมียาตามใบสั่งแพทย์ ยาที่ซื้อเอง หรืออาหารเสริมอื่น ๆ ให้แจ้งแพทย์หรือเภสัชกรก่อนว่ากำลังกินยาคุมอยู่
text.tl: Kung sasailalim ka sa operasyon, kailangang matagal na nakahiga, o umiinom ng iba pang prescription medicine, over-the-counter medicine, o supplement, sabihin muna sa doktor o pharmacist na umiinom ka ng birth control pills.
text.ja: 手術の予定がある場合、長期間安静が必要な場合、または他の処方薬・市販薬・サプリメントを使用している場合は、避妊薬を服用中であることを事前に医師または薬剤師へ伝えてください。

title.th: ดูกล่อง/แผงยาก่อน

text.zh-TW: 這包前 24 顆是有效錠，後 4 顆是無效錠。請從第 1 顆有效錠開始。若吃錯順序，已先吃到無效錠，今天改吃有效錠；接下來 7 天加用保險套。
text.en: The first 24 tablets are active. The last 4 tablets are inactive. Start with the first active tablet. If tablets were taken in the wrong order and you already took inactive tablets first, switch to an active tablet today and use condoms for the next 7 days.
text.id: 24 tablet pertama adalah tablet aktif. 4 tablet terakhir adalah tablet tidak aktif. Mulailah dari tablet aktif pertama. Jika urutan minum salah dan Anda sudah minum tablet tidak aktif lebih dulu, ganti dengan tablet aktif hari ini dan gunakan kondom selama 7 hari berikutnya.
text.vi: 24 viên đầu là viên có hoạt chất. 4 viên cuối là viên không hoạt chất. Hãy bắt đầu từ viên có hoạt chất đầu tiên. Nếu uống sai thứ tự và bạn đã uống viên không hoạt chất trước, hôm nay chuyển sang uống viên có hoạt chất và dùng bao cao su trong 7 ngày tiếp theo.
text.th: 24 เม็ดแรกเป็นเม็ดที่มีตัวยา และ 4 เม็ดสุดท้ายเป็นเม็ดไม่มีตัวยา ให้เริ่มจากเม็ดที่มีตัวยาเม็ดแรก หากกินผิดลำดับและเผลอกินเม็ดที่ไม่มีตัวยาไปก่อนแล้ว วันนี้ให้เปลี่ยนมากินเม็ดที่มีตัวยา และใช้ถุงยางใน 7 วันถัดไป
text.tl: Ang unang 24 na tableta ay aktibo. Ang huling 4 na tableta ay hindi aktibo. Magsimula sa unang aktibong tableta. Kung maling pagkakasunod ang nainom at nauna ang hindi aktibong tableta, lumipat sa aktibong tableta ngayong araw at gumamit ng condom sa susunod na 7 araw.
text.ja: 最初の24錠は有効錠、最後の4錠は無効錠です。最初の有効錠から始めてください。順番を間違えて無効錠を先に飲んでしまった場合は、今日から有効錠に切り替え、今後7日間はコンドームを併用してください。

action.zh-TW: 月經第 1～5 天，吃第 1 顆有效錠
action.en: On menstrual day 1 to 5, take the first active tablet
action.id: Pada hari haid ke-1 sampai ke-5, minum tablet aktif pertama
action.vi: Vào ngày 1 đến ngày 5 của kỳ kinh, uống viên có hoạt chất đầu tiên
action.th: เมื่อประจำเดือนมาวันที่ 1–5 ให้กินเม็ดยาที่มีตัวยาเม็ดแรก
action.tl: Sa araw 1 hanggang 5 ng regla, inumin ang unang aktibong tableta
action.ja: 月経1〜5日目に、最初の有効錠を飲む

note.zh-TW: 搭配白開水整顆吞服。第 1 天開始通常不需加用保險套；若第 2～5 天才開始，前 7 天加用保險套。
note.en: Swallow it whole with water. If you start on day 1, condoms are usually not needed. If you start on days 2 to 5, use condoms for the first 7 days.
note.id: Telan utuh dengan air putih. Jika mulai pada hari ke-1 haid, biasanya tidak perlu kondom. Jika mulai pada hari ke-2 sampai ke-5, gunakan kondom selama 7 hari pertama.
note.vi: Nuốt nguyên viên với nước lọc. Nếu bắt đầu vào ngày 1 của kỳ kinh, thường không cần thêm bao cao su. Nếu bắt đầu vào ngày 2 đến 5, dùng bao cao su trong 7 ngày đầu.
note.th: กลืนทั้งเม็ดกับน้ำเปล่า หากเริ่มวันที่ 1 ของประจำเดือน โดยทั่วไปไม่ต้องใช้ถุงยางเพิ่ม หากเริ่มวันที่ 2–5 ให้ใช้ถุงยางใน 7 วันแรก
note.tl: Lunukin nang buo kasama ng tubig. Kung nagsimula sa araw 1 ng regla, karaniwang hindi kailangan ng condom. Kung nagsimula sa araw 2 hanggang 5, gumamit ng condom sa unang 7 araw.
note.ja: 水でそのまま飲んでください。月経1日目に開始した場合、通常はコンドーム追加は不要です。2〜5日目に開始した場合は、最初の7日間コンドームを併用してください。

action.zh-TW: 每天固定時間吃 1 顆
action.en: Take 1 tablet at the same time each day
action.id: Minum 1 tablet pada waktu yang sama setiap hari
action.vi: Uống 1 viên vào cùng một giờ mỗi ngày
action.th: กินวันละ 1 เม็ด เวลาเดิมทุกวัน
action.tl: Uminom ng 1 tableta sa parehong oras araw-araw
action.ja: 毎日同じ時刻に1錠飲む

note.zh-TW: 依包裝順序吃。前 24 顆是有效錠，後 4 顆是無效錠。
note.en: Follow the order on the pack. The first 24 tablets are active. The last 4 tablets are inactive.
note.id: Ikuti urutan pada kemasan. 24 tablet pertama aktif, 4 tablet terakhir tidak aktif.
note.vi: Uống theo thứ tự trên vỉ. 24 viên đầu là viên có hoạt chất, 4 viên cuối là viên không hoạt chất.
note.th: กินตามลำดับบนแผงยา 24 เม็ดแรกเป็นเม็ดที่มีตัวยา และ 4 เม็ดสุดท้ายเป็นเม็ดไม่มีตัวยา
note.tl: Sundin ang pagkakasunod sa pakete. Ang unang 24 na tableta ay aktibo at ang huling 4 ay hindi aktibo.
note.ja: シートの順番どおりに飲みます。最初の24錠は有効錠、最後の4錠は無効錠です。

action.zh-TW: 吃完 28 顆後，隔天開新包
action.en: After 28 tablets, start a new pack the next day
action.id: Setelah 28 tablet habis, mulai kemasan baru keesokan harinya
action.vi: Uống hết 28 viên, hôm sau bắt đầu vỉ mới
action.th: กินครบ 28 เม็ดแล้ว เริ่มแผงใหม่ในวันถัดไป
action.tl: Pagkatapos ng 28 tableta, magsimula ng bagong pakete kinabukasan
action.ja: 28錠を飲み終えたら、翌日に新しいシートを始める

note.zh-TW: 不要停藥。月經通常在最後 4 顆無效錠期間來；Yaz 的雌激素較少，出血可能較少或沒來。
note.en: Do not take a break. Bleeding usually starts during the last 4 inactive tablets. Yaz has less estrogen, so bleeding may be lighter or absent.
note.id: Jangan berhenti minum obat. Perdarahan biasanya mulai saat 4 tablet tidak aktif terakhir. Yaz mengandung estrogen yang lebih sedikit, jadi perdarahan bisa lebih sedikit atau tidak ada.
note.vi: Không nghỉ thuốc. Máu thường ra trong 4 viên không hoạt chất cuối. Yaz có lượng estrogen ít hơn nên máu có thể ra ít hơn hoặc không ra.
note.th: ไม่ต้องหยุดยา เลือดมักออกในช่วง 4 เม็ดสุดท้ายที่ไม่มีตัวยา และเพราะ Yaz มีเอสโตรเจนน้อยกว่า เลือดอาจมาน้อยหรือไม่มาก็ได้
note.tl: Huwag magpahinga sa pills. Karaniwang nagsisimula ang pagdurugo habang iniinom ang huling 4 na hindi aktibong tableta. Mas kaunti ang estrogen sa Yaz kaya maaaring kaunti lang o walang dugo.
note.ja: 休薬はしません。通常、最後の4錠の無効錠の期間に出血が始まります。Yazはエストロゲン量が少ないため、出血が少ない、またはないことがあります。

action.en: If you miss 1 active tablet
action.id: Jika lupa 1 tablet aktif
action.vi: Quên 1 viên có hoạt chất
action.th: ลืมกินเม็ดยาที่มีตัวยา 1 เม็ด
action.tl: Kung nakalimutan ang 1 aktibong tableta
action.ja: 有効錠を1錠飲み忘れた場合

note.zh-TW: 想起時立刻補吃，後面照常吃。通常不需加用保險套。
note.en: Take it as soon as you remember, then continue as usual. Condoms are usually not needed.
note.id: Segera minum saat ingat, lalu lanjutkan seperti biasa. Biasanya tidak perlu kondom tambahan.
note.vi: Nhớ ra thì uống ngay, sau đó tiếp tục như thường lệ. Thường không cần dùng thêm bao cao su.
note.th: นึกได้ให้กินทันที แล้วกินต่อเหมือนเดิม โดยทั่วไปไม่ต้องใช้ถุงยางเพิ่ม
note.tl: Inumin agad kapag naalala, pagkatapos ay ituloy tulad ng dati. Karaniwan ay hindi kailangan ng condom.
note.ja: 気づいた時にすぐ飲み、その後は通常どおり続けます。通常はコンドーム追加は不要です。

action.zh-TW: 第 1～2 週漏吃 2 顆以上有效錠
action.en: If 2 or more active tablets are missed in weeks 1 to 2
action.id: Jika lupa 2 tablet aktif atau lebih pada minggu ke-1 sampai ke-2
action.vi: Quên từ 2 viên có hoạt chất trở lên trong tuần 1 đến 2
action.th: ลืมเม็ดยาที่มีตัวยาตั้งแต่ 2 เม็ดขึ้นไปในสัปดาห์ที่ 1–2
action.tl: Kung nakalimutan ang 2 o higit pang aktibong tableta sa linggo 1 hanggang 2
action.ja: 1〜2週目に有効錠を2錠以上飲み忘れた場合

note.zh-TW: 補最近漏的 1 顆，今天該吃的也照吃；其他漏掉的丟棄。接下來 7 天加用保險套。
note.en: Take the most recent missed tablet and also take today's tablet as scheduled. Discard the other missed tablets. Use condoms for the next 7 days.
note.id: Minum 1 tablet yang paling baru terlupa, dan minum tablet hari ini seperti biasa. Buang tablet lain yang terlupa. Gunakan kondom selama 7 hari berikutnya.
note.vi: Uống viên quên gần nhất và vẫn uống viên của hôm nay. Bỏ các viên quên còn lại. Dùng bao cao su trong 7 ngày tiếp theo.
note.th: กินเม็ดที่ลืมล่าสุด 1 เม็ด และกินเม็ดของวันนี้ตามปกติ ทิ้งเม็ดที่ลืมก่อนหน้านั้น และใช้ถุงยางใน 7 วันถัดไป
note.tl: Inumin ang pinakahuling nakalimutang tableta at inumin din ang para sa araw na ito. Itapon ang iba pang nakalimutan. Gumamit ng condom sa susunod na 7 araw.
note.ja: 直近で飲み忘れた1錠を飲み、その日の分も通常どおり飲みます。ほかの飲み忘れ分は捨て、今後7日間はコンドームを併用してください。

action.zh-TW: 最後 1 週漏吃 2 顆以上有效錠
action.en: If 2 or more active tablets are missed in the last active week
action.id: Jika lupa 2 tablet aktif atau lebih pada minggu aktif terakhir
action.vi: Quên từ 2 viên có hoạt chất trở lên trong tuần hoạt động cuối
action.th: ลืมเม็ดยาที่มีตัวยาตั้งแต่ 2 เม็ดขึ้นไปในสัปดาห์สุดท้ายของเม็ดที่มีตัวยา
action.tl: Kung nakalimutan ang 2 o higit pang aktibong tableta sa huling linggo ng aktibong tableta
action.ja: 最後の有効錠の週に2錠以上飲み忘れた場合

note.zh-TW: 補最近漏的 1 顆後，吃完剩餘有效錠。跳過 4 顆無效錠，隔天直接開新包；接下來 7 天加用保險套。
note.en: Take the most recent missed tablet, finish the remaining active tablets, skip the 4 inactive tablets, and start a new pack the next day. Use condoms for the next 7 days.
note.id: Minum 1 tablet yang paling baru terlupa, habiskan sisa tablet aktif, lewati 4 tablet tidak aktif, lalu mulai kemasan baru keesokan harinya. Gunakan kondom selama 7 hari berikutnya.
note.vi: Uống viên quên gần nhất, uống hết các viên có hoạt chất còn lại, bỏ qua 4 viên không hoạt chất và hôm sau bắt đầu vỉ mới. Dùng bao cao su trong 7 ngày tiếp theo.
note.th: กินเม็ดที่ลืมล่าสุด 1 เม็ด จากนั้นกินเม็ดที่มีตัวยาที่เหลือให้หมด ข้าม 4 เม็ดที่ไม่มีตัวยา แล้วเริ่มแผงใหม่ในวันถัดไป พร้อมใช้ถุงยางใน 7 วันถัดไป
note.tl: Inumin ang pinakahuling nakalimutang tableta, tapusin ang natitirang aktibong tableta, laktawan ang 4 na hindi aktibong tableta, at magsimula ng bagong pakete kinabukasan. Gumamit ng condom sa susunod na 7 araw.
note.ja: 直近で飲み忘れた1錠を飲み、残りの有効錠を飲み切ったら、4錠の無効錠は飛ばして翌日に新しいシートを始めます。今後7日間はコンドームを併用してください。

title.vi: Nôn ói hoặc tiêu chảy nặng
title.th: อาเจียนหรือท้องเสียรุนแรง

text.zh-TW: 吃有效錠後 3–4 小時內嘔吐，或有嚴重腹瀉，藥可能沒有吸收完全。請當作漏吃處理；若需要補 1 顆，可從另一包拿 1 顆補。
text.en: If you vomit within 3 to 4 hours after an active tablet, or have severe diarrhea, the pill may not have been fully absorbed. Treat it as a missed tablet. If you need 1 extra tablet, take it from another pack.
text.id: Jika Anda muntah dalam 3-4 jam setelah minum tablet aktif, atau mengalami diare berat, pil mungkin belum terserap sempurna. Perlakukan ini seperti tablet yang terlupa. Jika perlu menambah 1 tablet, ambil 1 tablet dari kemasan lain.
text.vi: Nếu bạn nôn trong vòng 3-4 giờ sau khi uống viên có hoạt chất, hoặc bị tiêu chảy nặng, thuốc có thể chưa được hấp thu hoàn toàn. Hãy xử lý như quên thuốc. Nếu cần bù 1 viên, lấy 1 viên từ vỉ khác để uống bù.
text.th: หากอาเจียนภายใน 3-4 ชั่วโมงหลังรับประทานเม็ดยาที่มีตัวยา หรือมีอาการท้องเสียรุนแรง ยาอาจยังดูดซึมไม่ครบ ให้ถือว่าเหมือนลืมยา หากต้องกินเพิ่ม 1 เม็ด ให้หยิบจากอีกแผงมาชดเชย 1 เม็ด
text.tl: Kung sumuka ka sa loob ng 3-4 oras matapos inumin ang aktibong tableta, o nagkaroon ng matinding pagtatae, maaaring hindi pa ganap na nasipsip ang gamot. Ituring ito na parang nakalimutang tableta. Kung kailangan ng dagdag na 1 tableta, kumuha ng 1 mula sa ibang pakete.
text.ja: 有効錠を飲んでから3〜4時間以内に嘔吐した場合、または重い下痢がある場合は、薬が十分に吸収されていない可能性があります。飲み忘れとして対応してください。1錠補う必要がある場合は、別のシートから1錠取って補ってください。

title.th: การเปลี่ยนแปลงของเลือดออก

text.zh-TW: 剛開始服用時，少量點狀出血可能發生，請不要自行停藥。Yaz 的雌激素較少，最後 4 顆無效錠期間出血可能很少或沒有；若都有按時吃藥，通常不代表身體受傷或避孕失效。若曾漏吃、連續 2 次都沒有出血且不放心，或有懷孕症狀，請驗孕或回診。
text.en: Light spotting may happen when you first start, so do not stop the pill on your own. Yaz has less estrogen, so bleeding during the last 4 inactive tablets may be very light or absent. If tablets were taken correctly, this usually does not mean harm or contraceptive failure. If tablets were missed, if there is no bleeding in 2 cycles in a row and you are worried, or if you have pregnancy symptoms, take a pregnancy test or return to the doctor.
text.id: Saat baru mulai minum, bercak darah ringan bisa terjadi. Jangan menghentikan pil sendiri. Yaz mengandung estrogen yang lebih sedikit, sehingga perdarahan saat 4 tablet tidak aktif terakhir bisa sangat sedikit atau tidak ada. Jika tablet diminum tepat waktu, hal ini biasanya tidak berarti tubuh Anda terluka atau kontrasepsi gagal. Jika pernah ada tablet yang terlewat, tidak ada perdarahan 2 siklus berturut-turut dan Anda khawatir, atau ada gejala kehamilan, lakukan tes kehamilan atau kembali ke dokter.
text.vi: Khi mới bắt đầu dùng thuốc, có thể xuất hiện ra huyết lấm tấm ít; đừng tự ý ngưng thuốc. Yaz có lượng estrogen ít hơn nên lượng máu ra trong 4 viên không hoạt chất cuối có thể rất ít hoặc không có. Nếu bạn vẫn uống thuốc đúng giờ, điều này thường không có nghĩa là cơ thể bị tổn thương hay thuốc mất tác dụng tránh thai. Nếu đã từng quên thuốc, không ra huyết 2 chu kỳ liên tiếp và bạn thấy lo, hoặc có triệu chứng mang thai, hãy thử thai hoặc đi khám lại.
text.th: เมื่อเริ่มใช้ยาใหม่ ๆ อาจมีเลือดกะปริบกะปรอยเล็กน้อยได้ อย่าหยุดยาเอง เนื่องจาก Yaz มีเอสโตรเจนน้อยกว่า เลือดออกในช่วง 4 เม็ดสุดท้ายที่ไม่มีตัวยาอาจมาน้อยมากหรือไม่มาเลย หากกินยาตรงเวลาสม่ำเสมอ โดยทั่วไปไม่ได้หมายความว่าร่างกายผิดปกติหรือยาคุมล้มเหลว หากเคยลืมยา ไม่มีเลือดออก 2 รอบติดกันแล้วกังวล หรือมีอาการสงสัยตั้งครรภ์ ให้ตรวจการตั้งครรภ์หรือกลับไปพบแพทย์
text.tl: Sa simula ng pag-inom, maaaring magkaroon ng kaunting spotting. Huwag itigil ang pills nang mag-isa. Mas kaunti ang estrogen sa Yaz kaya maaaring napakakaunti o wala ang pagdurugo habang iniinom ang huling 4 na hindi aktibong tableta. Kung nainom ang mga tableta sa tamang oras, karaniwan ay hindi ito nangangahulugang may pinsala sa katawan o pumalya ang kontrasepsyon. Kung may nakalimutang tableta, walang pagdurugo sa 2 magkasunod na cycle at nag-aalala ka, o may sintomas ng pagbubuntis, mag-pregnancy test o magpatingin muli.
text.ja: 飲み始めには少量の不正出血が起こることがあります。自己判断で中止しないでください。Yazはエストロゲン量が少ないため、最後の4錠の無効錠の期間の出血がごく少ない、またはないことがあります。時間どおりに正しく服用していれば、通常は体の異常や避妊失敗を意味しません。飲み忘れがあった、2周期続けて出血がなく不安がある、または妊娠症状がある場合は、妊娠検査をするか受診してください。

text.zh-TW: 胸痛、喘、單側小腿腫痛或突然視力模糊：停藥並立即就醫。
text.en: Chest pain, shortness of breath, one swollen painful calf, or sudden blurry vision: stop the pill and seek care now.
text.id: Nyeri dada, sesak napas, satu betis bengkak dan nyeri, atau penglihatan tiba-tiba kabur: hentikan pil dan segera cari pertolongan medis.
text.vi: Đau ngực, khó thở, một bên bắp chân sưng đau hoặc đột ngột mờ mắt: ngưng thuốc và đi khám ngay.
text.th: เจ็บหน้าอก หายใจลำบาก น่องข้างเดียวบวมเจ็บ หรือจู่ ๆ ตามัว: หยุดยาและพบแพทย์ทันที
text.tl: Pananakit ng dibdib, hingal, isang binti na namamaga at masakit, o biglang paglabo ng paningin: ihinto ang pills at magpatingin agad.
text.ja: 胸痛、息切れ、片側のふくらはぎの腫れや痛み、または急な視界のぼやけ：服用を中止し、直ちに受診してください。

text.zh-TW: 避孕藥不能預防性病；需要時仍要用保險套。
text.en: Birth control pills do not prevent STIs. Use condoms when needed.
text.id: Pil KB tidak mencegah infeksi menular seksual; gunakan kondom bila perlu.
text.vi: Thuốc tránh thai không phòng bệnh lây qua đường tình dục; dùng bao cao su khi cần.
text.th: ยาคุมกำเนิดไม่ป้องกันโรคติดต่อทางเพศสัมพันธ์ ควรใช้ถุงยางเมื่อจำเป็น
text.tl: Hindi pinipigilan ng birth control pills ang sexually transmitted infections; gumamit ng condom kung kailangan.
text.ja: 避妊薬は性感染症を予防できません。必要な時はコンドームを使ってください。

text.zh-TW: 所有處方藥、成藥與保健品，先告知醫師或藥師。
text.en: Tell your doctor or pharmacist about all prescription medicines, over-the-counter medicines, and supplements.
text.id: Beri tahu dokter atau apoteker tentang semua obat resep, obat bebas, dan suplemen.
text.vi: Hãy báo cho bác sĩ hoặc dược sĩ tất cả thuốc kê đơn, thuốc không kê đơn và thực phẩm bổ sung.
text.th: แจ้งแพทย์หรือเภสัชกรเกี่ยวกับยาตามใบสั่งแพทย์ ยาที่ซื้อเอง และอาหารเสริมทั้งหมด
text.tl: Ipaalam sa doktor o pharmacist ang lahat ng prescription medicine, over-the-counter medicine, at supplement.
text.ja: 処方薬、市販薬、サプリメントはすべて医師または薬剤師に伝えてください。
